records.title: Stream 2.11 Information/Record Management/Recordkeeping Specialists
records.body: The objective of this requirement is to acquire ATIP consultant services under TSPS Stream 2, Category 2.11, to provide Access to Information and Privacy (ATIP) services under the Access to Information Act and Privacy Act and expert advice on ATIP issues to all levels of NRCan’s management and staff, its stakeholders and requestors.
